name: factory-loop
description: Draft, not yet shipped: the issue orchestrator as one deterministic code loop inside its Claude Code session. This build observes only: it reads the factory every minute, plans, logs its decisions and shows its status in the session title, and executes nothing.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off, observe (plan and log, execute nothing) or act. This build has no executors, so act also executes nothing.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: owner/name to run for; empty means the session checkout's GitHub origin

shadowDevice.title: Shadow device
shadowDevice.description: Observe mode only: plan as this device (a live orchestrator's) to shadow its work

runSource.title: Run source
runSource.description: local (the pipeline watcher) or events (the event log, for a shadow run)
